title: hanger organizer
text: hanger organizer. This doesn't really help if you have overstuffed your closet.  However, if you would like a different version of organization of your clothing items and you have NOT overstuffed your closet, you may like these.  What happens is that the thickness of your clothing is just transferred - lower.  So if you have really thin clothing - lots of thin blouse and/or t's... you could use these to organize color, etc.  My challenge is that my closet rod is super high... but I have too many things in my closets.  I need to thin out the closet and these may help some - but I will likely not purchase more of them.  I can't ding them too hard because they actually work - BUT not for most closets.  Also, I have a lot of thicker plastic hangers - these clearly work better with thinner, metal hook hangers.  I have thinner pincher type hangers for hanging pants and skirts, and found they worked much better than the thicker plastic hangers.  Eh.  For me the worked about zero stars... but if you have a very loose closet, thin clothing and metal hangers, they would help some.  I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.  And really hope this info was helpful to you.
